seedFormula: fight k (0-based), seed s (1..seeds): seedRun(s * 7919 + k)
assumptions: Builds are test inputs, not live players: the four saved genin jutsu from the live library (all D-rank), at level 5 for L10 and 8 for L15, Lightning primary element.

Stats: the level's player stat budget (scaleUserStats) spread evenly over the six combat stats; pools from calcHP/CP/SP for the level; every mastery 10; no preferred generals, bloodline, gear, items or pets.
Not modelled: skills, titles, raid buffs, cooking, village and faction relations, clan, ANBU squad, loadouts, sage mode (see builds[].notModelled).

Player policy: the default rotation (self buffs when ready, each attack jutsu when the closest enemy is in range, close in, basic attack, end turn), executed by the engine's AI selector; with dodge on, a player standing on an enemy telegraph steps to the nearest unmarked hex first.
Each floor and the Captain are separate fights with a full restore between them, 10 seeds each, capped at 120 rounds (stalled at the cap counts as not won).
Parties are three copies of the same build.
